strategy_lines.label: Audience
strategy_lines.text: US manufacturers with 200 to 1,000 employees that run NetSuite or Sage Intacct and process more than 2,000 supplier invoices a month. Roles: CFO, Controller, AP manager.

strategy_lines.label: Offer
strategy_lines.text: The Month-End Close Benchmark: a 20-minute read-out that shows where a manufacturer's close loses days, built from the buyer's own AP numbers. CTA: Book a close review.

strategy_lines.label: Message
strategy_lines.text: Brasswick cuts invoice approval from 9 days to 2 for manufacturers on NetSuite or Sage Intacct, so the books close on day 4. Proof: Three named manufacturing customers closed on day 4 within two quarters of go-live.

strategy_lines.label: Channel: LinkedIn ads
strategy_lines.text: LinkedIn ads (paid social), $40,000 at $200 a lead

strategy_lines.label: Tracking
strategy_lines.text: Every lead gets the Salesforce campaign brasswick-q1 on creation. Opportunities created within 90 days of a campaign touch take it as primary campaign source.

strategy_lines.label: Funnel
strategy_lines.text: Average deal $30,000, 8% of leads become opportunities in 21 days
